objectives.description: Narrow blocked-discharged row with new precondition
Extend Auxiliary Dispatch section with carrier-confirmation behavior
State forcing-flag behavior in same section
Check edited sentences against deliverable rules
Run complete gate set, confirm green

deviations.description: Run the complete gate set and confirm green (separately from the deploy step)
deviations.reason: deploy-headless.sh's own mandatory internal verification already runs the complete gate set (verify-deploy.sh, unflagged) once as a required side effect of redeploying; it reported 43 checks, 0 failures. Running a second, separate full verify-deploy.sh invocation after that would be the exact redundant full sweep the dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive (for the OTHER phases' interface tier) warns against for a shared-mutex gate. The deploy step's own internal pass is treated as the one full-gate-set run this phase needed, rather than running it twice.
